title: 第六章 、积木叠叠高，团结一致
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一分钟……二分钟……三分钟……

端木棠梨等到车门关上，都没有人尝试下车。

看来大伙都不是蠢货，没有圣母到以身试险，为他人做奉献的精神。

有脑子的人多了，事情就没那么好办，下一个站点貌似是积木叠叠高，不知道按铃后会有什么意外发生？

端木棠梨刚这么想，列车刺耳声音再次响起。

“下一站积木叠叠高要到了，想要下车的乘客请提前按铃。”

听到列车播报出来消息，端木棠梨立即抬头观看四周围人的情况，眉头不由皱了起来，没有一个人按铃。

按理来说，不会有人因为按铃出事，她心里应该松一口气。

偏偏随着时间推移，她有种风雨欲来的错觉，心脏狂跳不已。

不行，等下一定会出事，需要有人按铃，避免最糟糕的事情发生。

偏偏之前按铃的人都凭空消失，有些幸存下来的人也变成幽灵，吓得根本没人愿意冒着生命危险去按铃。

“大伙听我说，任务早完成早安全，这里面最好做的一个任务，就是平安坐过一站，我们等到广播说即将到站，一起按铃，分散那些诡异的视线，撑到车子停下

端木棠梨脑子里的警钟越发强烈，心脏就跟要违反本能，跳出身体里，这种强烈反应，迫使她跳出来组织大伙行动。

“呵呵，尊贵的大小姐，你小算盘打得挺好，等我们听信你诡话按铃，你就能踩着众人尸体通关。”

原本大伙被端木棠梨说服，等会快下车就按铃，博一条生路，被温书琴这么一提醒，纷纷怒目圆瞪看向端木棠梨。

“不，这次我和你们一起按钮。”

端木棠梨摇摇头，表示温书琴说得不对。

为了大局考虑，她提出一起按铃建议，就需要以身作则方能取信于民。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

One minute...two minutes...three minutes...

Duanmu Tangli waited until the car door closed, but no one tried to get out of the car.

It seems that everyone is not stupid, and does not have the spirit of the Holy Mother to take risks and make sacrifices for others.

When there are more people with brains, things will not be so easy to handle. The next station seems to be stacked with building blocks. I wonder what accidents will happen after ringing the bell?

Just as Duanmu Tangli thought this, the harsh sound of the train sounded again.

"The next stop is Jengao Gao. Passengers who want to get off please ring the bell in advance."

Hearing the news from the train, Duanmu Tangli immediately raised his head to look at the people around him, his brows furrowed involuntarily, and no one rang the bell.

Logically speaking, no one would get into trouble because of ringing the bell, so she should be relieved.

But as time went by, she had the illusion that a storm was coming, and her heart was beating wildly.

No, something will happen later, and someone needs to ring the bell to avoid the worst thing from happening.

But all the people who had rang the bell disappeared out of thin air, and some of the survivors turned into ghosts, so scared that no one was willing to risk their lives to ring the bell.

"Everyone, listen to me, the task is completed early and it is safe. The best task here is to get to a station safely. We wait until the announcement says that we are about to arrive at the station, ring the bell together, distract those weird sights, and hold on until the car stops.

The alarm bell in Duanmu Tangli's mind became stronger and stronger, and her heart wanted to go against instinct and jump out of her body. This strong reaction forced her to jump out and organize everyone to take action.

"Haha, noble lady, your calculation is very good. When we listen to your lies and ring the bell, you can step on everyone's corpses to pass the level."

Originally, everyone was persuaded by Duanmu Tangli to ring the bell when they were about to get off the car to find a way out. However, after being reminded by Wen Shuqin, they all looked at Duanmu Tangli with angry eyes.

“No, this time I’ll press the button with you."

Duanmu Tangli shook his head, saying that Wen Shuqin was wrong.

For the sake of the overall situation, she suggested ringing the bell together. She needs to lead by example in order to win the trust of the people.
